chunks: And in the narration of Al-ʿAlāʾ from Al-Thumālī, he said:
If a man were to strike another man with a whip, Allah would strike him with a whip of the Fire.

key_terms.سَوْطًا: a whip or lash used for striking
key_terms.ضَرَبَ رَجُلًا: struck another man; an act of physical aggression against another person
key_terms.مِنَ النَّارِ: from the Fire; indicating punishment in the hereafter

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about striking another person unjustly?
ai.summary: This hadith warns severely against physically harming another person, even with a single whip-strike. It presents such aggression as a sin that incurs punishment in the afterlife, underscoring the sanctity of others' bodily rights.
